Summary

This PoC targets the “Integration for Keap/Infusionsoft” WordPress plugin, whose cf7-infusionsoft.php file calls maybe_unserialize() on user-supplied form field values without validation. An unauthenticated attacker can submit a crafted PHP serialized object through the plugin’s AJAX endpoints (or, as a fallback, direct form/REST submission paths), causing the server to instantiate arbitrary PHP objects. Combined with a POP gadget chain present in other installed plugins/themes, this can escalate to remote code execution; on its own it can enable file deletion or information disclosure via built-in PHP classes like SplFileInfo.
